title: Will a Spy Scandal, Trade Friction and a Surprise Guest Ruin Xi’s Big Moment?
summary_full: The leader wants the APEC summit to showcase China’s strengths, but he faces export worries and an unpredictable Trump, who has floated meeting Kim Jong-un.
